Register_Fields: data_in, intr_raw_sts, intr_clr, pedge_intr_en, nedge_intr_en, level_sel, io_ctrl, dout
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset applied; GPIO block powered on and clocked
Test_Steps: 1. Apply hardware reset (hreset_n asserted then deasserted). 2. Read all 49 GPIO register addresses sequentially. 3. Mask read data with read_mask_array. 4. Compare against default_value_array.

Pass_Criteria: Read data (masked) == default_value_array[i] for all registers

Test_Description: Verify write and read-back of multiple data patterns to all writable GPIO registers. Uses 6 patterns: 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xAAAAAAAA, 0x55555555, 0xF5F5F5F5, 0xA5A5A5A5, 0xFFFF0000.
Registers_Tested: gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_39, gpio_intr_raw_stclr1, gp0_intr1_intr_en1, gp0_intr2_intr_en1
Register_Fields: pedge_intr_en, nedge_intr_en, level_sel, io_ctrl, dout, intr_en, intr_raw_stclr
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset applied; GPIO block powered on and clocked
Test_Steps: 1. For each of 6 data patterns: a. Write (pattern & write_mask) to each writable register. b. Read back each register. c. Compute expected = (pattern & read_mask & write_mask) | (~write_mask & read_mask & default_value). d. Compare read data against expected value. 2. VRRW registers (offsets 0x94-0xC0) are skipped via skip_array.
Expected_Result: Read-back data must match expected computed value for all 6 patterns across all writable registers.
Pass_Criteria: data_rd == exp_val for all patterns and all registers

Test_Description: Verify GPIO level-sensitive interrupt generation with active-high level selection. Tests all 32 GPIO pins (GPIO_8 to GPIO_39) for level-1 interrupt triggering.
Registers_Tested: gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_39, gp0_intr1_intr_en1, gp0_intr1_intr_sts1, gpio_intr_raw_stclr1, LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1
Register_Fields: level_sel, io_ctrl, intr_raw_sts, intr_clr, G8_intr_en-G39_intr_en, G8_intr_sts-G39_intr_sts
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset applied; GIC IRQ 87 (GPIO0) or 88 (GPIO1) enabled; LSS sysreg interrupt enabled for GPIO0/GPIO1
Test_Steps: 1. Enable GIC IRQ for GPIO0 (IRQ 87). 2. Enable LSS sysreg interrupt for GPIO0. 3. For each GPIO pin i (0 to 31): a. Write 0x00180000 to gp0_gpio_8+(i*4) to set input mode (bit[20]=1) and level_sel=1 (bit[19]=1). b. Enable group interrupt for pin i: write (1<<i) to gp0_intr1_intr_en1 (0x84). c. Write 0xFFFFFFFF to SRAM trigger (0xA0243FFC). d. Wait for interrupt. 4. In ISR: a. Read gp0_gpio_8+(i*4) and verify intr_raw_sts (bit[1]) is set. b. Read gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 (0x88) and verify bit[i] is set. c. Clear interrupt by writing 0x00110000 to gp0_gpio_8+(i*4). d. Verify interrupt cleared. e. Disable group interrupt. f. Clear LSS sysreg raw status.
Expected_Result: Interrupt must be generated for each GPIO pin when input level matches level_sel=1. Raw status and group status must reflect correctly. Interrupt must clear properly.
Pass_Criteria: intr_raw_sts (bit[1]) != 0; intr_sts1 bit[i] != 0; After clear: rdata == 0x100001; group_sts == 0x0; sysreg cleared

Test_Description: Verify GPIO level-sensitive interrupt generation with active-low level selection. Tests all 32 GPIO pins (GPIO_8 to GPIO_39) for level-0 interrupt triggering.
Registers_Tested: gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_39, gp0_intr1_intr_en1, gp0_intr1_intr_sts1, gpio_intr_raw_stclr1, LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1
Register_Fields: level_sel, io_ctrl, intr_raw_sts, intr_clr, G8_intr_en-G39_intr_en, G8_intr_sts-G39_intr_sts
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset applied; GIC IRQ 87 (GPIO0) or 88 (GPIO1) enabled; LSS sysreg interrupt enabled for GPIO0/GPIO1
Test_Steps: 1. Enable GIC IRQ for GPIO0 (IRQ 87). 2. Enable LSS sysreg interrupt for GPIO0. 3. For each GPIO pin i (0 to 31): a. Write 0x00100000 to gp0_gpio_8+(i*4) to set input mode (bit[20]=1) and level_sel=0 (bit[19]=0). b. Enable group interrupt for pin i: write (1<<i) to gp0_intr1_intr_en1 (0x84). c. Write ~(1<<i) to SRAM trigger (0xA0243FFC) to drive pin low. d. Wait for interrupt. 4. In ISR: a. Read gp0_gpio_8+(i*4) and verify intr_raw_sts (bit[1]) is set. b. Read gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 (0x88) and verify bit[i] is set. c. Clear interrupt by writing to intr_clr. d. Verify interrupt cleared. e. Disable group interrupt. f. Clear LSS sysreg raw status.
Expected_Result: Interrupt must be generated for each GPIO pin when input level matches level_sel=0 (active low). Raw status and group status must reflect correctly. Interrupt must clear properly.
Pass_Criteria: intr_raw_sts (bit[1]) != 0; intr_sts1 bit[i] != 0; After clear: interrupt cleared; group_sts == 0x0; sysreg cleared

Test_Description: Verify GPIO IO control register configures pin as input mode. Write io_ctrl=1 (bit[20]) and verify data_in reflects external pin value.
Registers_Tested: gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_39, gpio_io_ctrl_group1, gpio_io_ctrl_group2, gpio_io_ctrl_group3, gpio_io_ctrl_group4
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset applied; GPIO block powered on
Test_Steps: 1. For each GPIO pin: a. Write io_ctrl=1 (bit[20]=1) to set input mode. b. Read data_in (bit[0]) to verify it reflects external pin level. 2. Alternatively use group register gpio_io_ctrl_group1-4 with mask bits cleared to configure multiple pins.
Expected_Result: data_in bit should reflect the actual external pin level when io_ctrl is set to input mode.

Test_Description: Verify GPIO IO control register configures pin as output mode. Write io_ctrl=0 (bit[20]) and dout value, then verify pin drives the written value.
Registers_Tested: gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_39, gpio_dout_group1, gpio_dout_group2, gpio_dout_group3, gpio_dout_group4
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset applied; GPIO block powered on
Test_Steps: 1. For each GPIO pin: a. Write io_ctrl=0 (bit[20]=0) to set output mode. b. Write dout=1 (bit[21]=1) to drive high. c. Verify pin output is high. d. Write dout=0 (bit[21]=0) to drive low. e. Verify pin output is low. 2. Alternatively use group register gpio_dout_group1-4 with mask bits cleared.
Expected_Result: Pin output must match the dout value when io_ctrl is set to output mode.

Test_Description: Verify positive-edge interrupt detection. Enable pedge_intr_en (bit[17]) and verify interrupt is generated on rising edge of GPIO input.
Registers_Tested: gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_39, gp0_intr1_intr_en1, gp0_intr1_intr_sts1, gpio_intr_raw_stclr1
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset applied; GPIO in input mode; GIC enabled
Test_Steps: 1. Set GPIO to input mode (io_ctrl=1). 2. Enable positive edge interrupt (pedge_intr_en=1, bit[17]). 3. Enable group interrupt in gp0_intr1_intr_en1. 4. Apply rising edge on GPIO input pin. 5. Verify intr_raw_sts (bit[1]) is set. 6. Verify group interrupt status. 7. Clear interrupt via intr_clr (bit[16]).
Expected_Result: Interrupt raw status must be set on rising edge. Group interrupt status must reflect. Interrupt must clear on writing intr_clr.
Pass_Criteria: intr_raw_sts set on posedge; cleared after intr_clr write

Test_Description: Verify group data input registers (gpio_din_group1-4) reflect the current input values of all GPIO pins when configured in input mode.
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset applied; All GPIO pins in input mode
Test_Steps: 1. Configure all GPIO pins to input mode. 2. Apply known input pattern to GPIO pins. 3. Read gpio_din_group1 (0xB4) for GPIO 8-15. 4. Read gpio_din_group2 (0xB8) for GPIO 16-23. 5. Read gpio_din_group3 (0xBC) for GPIO 24-31. 6. Read gpio_din_group4 (0xC0) for GPIO 32-39. 7. Verify read values match applied input pattern.

Pass_Criteria: din bits match applied input pattern

Test_Description: Verify group data output registers (gpio_dout_group1-4) drive correct output values to GPIO pins when configured in output mode with write mask cleared.
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset applied; All GPIO pins in output mode
Test_Steps: 1. Configure all GPIO pins to output mode via group io_ctrl registers (mask=0). 2. Write dout pattern to gpio_dout_group1-4 with wr_mask bits cleared (bits[16:23]=0). 3. Verify GPIO output pins drive the written dout values. 4. Write complementary pattern and verify again.
Expected_Result: GPIO output pins must match the dout values written via group registers when write mask is cleared.

Test_Description: Verify consolidated interrupt raw status and clear register (gpio_intr_raw_stclr1 at 0x80). Read returns latched raw interrupt status for all 32 GPIOs. Writing 1 clears the corresponding interrupt.
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset applied; Interrupts triggered on multiple GPIO pins
Test_Steps: 1. Trigger interrupts on multiple GPIO pins. 2. Read gpio_intr_raw_stclr1 (0x80) and verify corresponding bits are set. 3. Write 1 to specific bits to clear those interrupts. 4. Read back and verify cleared bits are 0. 5. Verify writing 0 has no effect on status bits.
Expected_Result: Raw status bits must reflect triggered interrupts. Writing 1 must clear the corresponding bit. Writing 0 must have no effect.
Pass_Criteria: Status bits set for triggered pins; cleared after write-1; no change on write-0

Test_Description: Verify second interrupt group registers (gp0_intr2_intr_en1 at 0x8C and gp0_intr2_intr_sts1 at 0x90). Enable interrupts via intr2 group and verify masked status reflects correctly.
Test_Steps: 1. Enable specific GPIO interrupts via gp0_intr2_intr_en1 (0x8C). 2. Trigger interrupts on those GPIO pins. 3. Read gp0_intr2_intr_sts1 (0x90) and verify masked status bits are set only for enabled pins. 4. Disable interrupts and verify masked status clears.
Expected_Result: Masked status must reflect only enabled interrupt sources. Disabled interrupts must not appear in masked status.

Test_Description: Verify IO control write mask functionality in group registers. When write mask bit is 1 the corresponding io_ctrl value is ignored; when 0 it is applied.
Test_Steps: 1. Write io_ctrl=0 with wr_mask=0 for a GPIO pin via group register. Verify pin switches to output mode. 2. Write io_ctrl=1 with wr_mask=1 for same pin. Verify pin remains in output mode (mask prevents write). 3. Write io_ctrl=1 with wr_mask=0. Verify pin switches to input mode.
Expected_Result: Write mask=1 must prevent io_ctrl update. Write mask=0 must allow io_ctrl update.
Pass_Criteria: mask=0: io_ctrl applied; mask=1: io_ctrl ignored

Test_Description: Verify dout write mask functionality in group registers. When write mask bit is 1 the corresponding dout value is ignored; when 0 it is applied.
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset applied; GPIO pins in output mode
Test_Steps: 1. Set GPIO to output mode. 2. Write dout=1 with wr_mask=0. Verify output is high. 3. Write dout=0 with wr_mask=1. Verify output remains high (mask prevents write). 4. Write dout=0 with wr_mask=0. Verify output goes low.
Expected_Result: Write mask=1 must prevent dout update. Write mask=0 must allow dout update.
Pass_Criteria: mask=0: dout applied; mask=1: dout ignored
